remarks: Located in the desirable Lake Wind / Ponus Ridge corridor, this custom Colonial estate offers over 9,000 square feet of living space, thoughtfully rebuilt in 2010 and designed for both scale and comfort. The home features 5 bedrooms, 7 full and 3 half baths, six fireplaces (including one outdoor), and multiple porches, with select rooms showcasing cathedral ceilings. Set on 2.74 acres, the property includes a saltwater pool and spa, pool house, expansive flagstone patio, and tennis court-creating a true estate setting with exceptional potential for outdoor living and entertaining. The interior presents with a clean, functional layout, including a recently installed boiler, while exterior amenities and select finishes offer a compelling opportunity for renovation and customization, allowing the next owner to fully realize the property's potential. A rare offering combining size, privacy, and long-term upside in one of New Canaan's premier estate areas.
